notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Beat matching and ergonomy improvements, new dance tracks to replace the sample ones

notes.title: Multi Update
notes.notes:
- Updated SteamVR to, hopefully, deal with the black screen appearing in some setups
- Beat matcher updates
- Lightmap updates
- Narrowed hook angle a bit more

notes.title: Warp speed
notes.notes:
- Added a new speed level, Warp. It's the same timing as Fury which now becomes a little slower for a smoother transition from Fast
- Narrowed down the hooks angle a bit

notes.title: Updates
notes.notes:
- Added a menu option to exit the game to prevent accidental quitting
- Slightly adjusted target/bar timings to make the game playable on fury
- Slightly adjusted angles, especially on uppercuts/high hooks
- Updated lightmaps

notes.title: Beat Matching extravaganza
notes.notes: The beatmaps are matching the music even better now especially on rock/rap tracks(Dance was already working great)

notes.title: Beat matching improvements
notes.notes: Narrow band to lower parts of the spectrum. Improvement on most tracks but fur elise didn't make the cut too quiet. In its place 3 new sample tracks of various genres

notes.title: Bad Ninjas
notes.notes:
- New gameplay option, block ninja strikes
- Improvements to the beat matching algorithm
- Progress bar to indicate the current track position 
- Better particles wind behavior and lighting improvements
- Improved mp3 loading. Playback starts instantly and supports huge files, tested with hour long dj sets

notes.title: Beat Ninjas
notes.notes: As you may have noticed the new beat matching is out of this world. And the best is yet to come, just keep beating the sh!t out of the ninjas to make them angry enough ;)

notes.title: More yield
notes.notes: Final, all beats are assigned to bars or targets

notes.title: Better yield
notes.notes: Full bar and target yield from the new engine

notes.title: Beat match
notes.notes: Engine updated to beat match the music
